items.source: Mark a class to use compound indexes.
items.translation: 标记一个类以使用复合索引。

items.source:
@Document
@CompoundIndex(def = "{'firstname': 1, 'lastname': 1}")
@CompoundIndex(def = "{'address.city': 1, 'address.street': 1}")
class Person {
        String firstname;
        String lastname;

        Address address;
}
items.translation:
@Document
@CompoundIndex(def = "{'firstname': 1, 'lastname': 1}")
@CompoundIndex(def = "{'address.city': 1, 'address.street': 1}")
class Person {
        String firstname;
        String lastname;

        Address address;
}

items.source: If true the index will be created in the background.
items.translation: 如果为真，索引将在后台创建。

items.source: The actual collation definition in JSON format or a template expression resolving to either a JSON String or a Document. The keys of the JSON document are configuration options for the collation (language-specific rules for string comparison) to be applied on string properties being part of the index.
items.translation: 实际的排序定义采用 JSON 格式，或是一个解析为 JSON 字符串或 Document 的模板表达式。JSON 文档的键是应用于索引中字符串属性的排序配置选项（即针对字符串比较的语言特定规则）。
